cues: Put the two side by side.
Gravimetric work measures a mass, with a balance, a crucible and a furnace.
It is slow, but extremely accurate.
Volumetric work measures a volume, with a burette, a pipette and a volumetric flask.
It is fast, accurate to about a tenth of a percent, and usually needs an indicator.
That speed is why routine laboratories titrate.
